mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates an ultra-accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal Funds Rate cut to 0.00-0.25% on March 15, 2020
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns downward over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Unemployment rate rose to 5.9% in March 2020 (from 3.5% in February)
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based consumer demand collapse, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST fell to 956.0 (from 1000.0 in February) and RSAFS fell to 442689.0 (from 450000.0 in February)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a pandemic-induced economic shock, a monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 5% signals a severe supply disruption, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Industrial production fell 5.4% in March 2020 (from February)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines > 5% in 1 month during a pandemic shock.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5% consistently indicates a weak labor market, which suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals a shift toward monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal Funds Rate at 0.09% in March 2020
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth signal a deepening economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% in 2 months and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in last quarter
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST fell to 956.0 (from 1000.0 in February) and GDPC1 at 16010.4 (decline from prior quarter)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in their respective periods.

mechanism_narrative: During a low-rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%), a monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals a worsening economic outlook, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
evidence_refs: fact:FEDFUNDS at 0.09% and UNRATE at 5.9% (with 2.4pp rise from February)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.
